targets.rawSql: select percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by duration_seconds) value from observability.dbt_run_history where $__timeFilter(started_at)
select percentile_cont(0.95) within group(order by duration_seconds) value from observability.dbt_run_history where $__timeFilter(started_at)
select 100.0*count(*) filter(where status='failed')/nullif(count(*),0) value from observability.dbt_run_history where $__timeFilter(started_at)
select count(*) value from observability.dbt_model_run_history where status not in('success','pass','skipped') and executed_at>=now()-interval '7 days'
select started_at time,duration_seconds value,status metric from observability.dbt_run_history where $__timeFilter(started_at) order by started_at

panels.title: Model failures in last 7 days, ranked

targets.rawSql: select model_name,count(*) failure_count,max(executed_at) last_failure,max(error_message) last_error from observability.dbt_model_run_history where status not in('success','pass','skipped') and executed_at>=now()-interval '7 days' group by model_name order by failure_count desc,last_failure desc
